_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-20. CardID = 17600 + idx; 320 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 20). Sun Wukong's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the turtles', Eredin's and the rest: only deck.identity (data/tts/sun-wukong.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Hero card (read from the image): SUN WUKONG, MELEE, START HEALTH 17, MOVE 2; special ability 'At the start of your turn, you may take 1 damage to summon a Clone in an empty space adjacent to Sun Wukong. Do not start with any Clones on the board.' Sidekick CLONES, MELEE, START HEALTH 1 x3, move 2 (the save has three Custom_Token objects nicknamed Clone, no life dial).

Every card of the deck is band ANY (read from the images). Order on the sheet: Ox Form 0-1, Ruyi Jingo Bang 2-4, Taunting Laughter 5-7, Infinite Strikes 8-10, Sly Monkey 11-14, 72 Transformations 15-17, Wily Fighting 18-20, Bewilderment 21-22, Tortoise Form 23-24, Golden Chain Mail 25-26, Fiery Eyes That See 27-28, Phoenix Form 29.
Text differs from unmatched-memory on Bewilderment: the card says 'Prevent all combat damage' (unmatched-memory: 'Prevent all damage'); the card wins.
